svg.aria-label: Experience. 4 products live; 114 tests on stratos; 3,000+ contributions / 12 mo; 800+ students reached at ub. Software Engineering Intern at Daiwa Capital Markets America, jun 2026 — now: Automating day-to-day corporate and financial workflows at the US arm of a global investment bank. Co-founder at COA, may 2026 — now: Building an agentic B2C SaaS that solves the context layer for cross-platform workflows. Outreach Chair at Society of Computing at UB, fall 2026 — now: Connecting CS students with industry and the wider university community. Data Analyst Trainee at MedTourEasy, jun 2025: Cleaned and wrangled real healthcare data with SQL, then turned the EDA into Tableau insights. Undergraduate Research Assistant at UB College of Arts & Sciences, feb 2025 — now: Researching how VR and immersive media shape moral decisions, across age groups.
